query:
UPDATE crm_companies co
            SET hidden = EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM crm_domains own
                JOIN crm_blocked_domains bd
                  ON bd.team_id = own.team_id
                 AND bd.domain = LOWER(own.domain)
                WHERE own.company_id = co.id
                  AND own.team_id = $1
            )
            FROM crm_domains d
            WHERE d.company_id = co.id
              AND d.team_id = $1
              AND co.team_id = $1
              AND LOWER(d.domain) = $2
